findings.current: {count, plural, other {重连中 · 上次同步于 # 秒前}} / {count, plural, other {重连中 · 上次同步于 # 分钟前}}
findings.proposed: {count, plural, other {重连中 · 上次同步：# 秒前}} / {count, plural, other {重连中 · 上次同步：# 分钟前}}
findings.reason: 「同步于 # 秒前」is a word-for-word rendering of 'synced # seconds ago'; 于 marks a point in time (「同步于 14:30」), not an offset, so 「同步于 1 秒前」is not idiomatic Chinese UI copy. The colon form keeps the English subject order and the full-width colon this locale uses.

findings.current: 点击“新建”开始对话，或在电脑上用 Local Operator 开始
findings.proposed: 点击“新建”开始对话，或在电脑上用Local Operator开始
findings.reason: i18n/style-guides/zh-CN.md forbids a space between Chinese text and a Latin/digit run, and the locale's own product-name precedent follows it (cli.browser.json: 「加载Local Operator扩展」). Only string in the namespace that spaces a Latin run; cosmetic, no meaning error.

This locale's established rendering of 'Loading …' is 正在加载… (relay.session ×3, relay.shell, tui.hub_links, tui.review); 读取 is used for 'reading …' (relay.asks 'reading asks…', tui.library 'Reading the library…'). 读取对话 is understandable, but one English term should map to one Chinese term.

The same English token 'Reconnecting' renders as 正在重连 in the standalone subtitle and as 重连中 in link.since_seconds/since_minutes, which appear on the same line as the state escalates. Both forms are idiomatic; unify.

'Dismiss' is rendered 忽略 throughout relay.ask, relay.asks and tui.asks (dismiss a question without replying). Here the object is a transient snackbar, where 关闭 is the correct word and 忽略 would import the asks meaning. Drift is real; recommend keeping the text and recording the context-scoped exception in the glossary rather than changing it.

findings.proposed: 未响应 (keep; align the others or record the choice)
findings.reason: The same English 'not answering' is 无响应 in tui.small.info_panel.not_answering and in relay.asks.error.read_timeout. 未响应 is the more common product string and is internally consistent in this namespace, so this is a repo-wide alignment nit, not a defect of this file.
